entities.name: Alphabet - Alphabet Inc.
entities.brief: Parent company of Google with multiple business segments
entities.description: Alphabet is highlighted as the document's main issuer, with strong search and cloud revenue growth, and AI as a key driver.

entities.name: Alphabet - 2025 Wiz Acquisition Announcement
entities.brief: Announcement of proposed Wiz acquisition by Alphabet
entities.description: Material M&A event, Alphabet's proposed acquisition of Wiz, Inc. announced on March 18, 2025.

entities.name: Alphabet - BofA Price Objective
entities.brief: BofA price objective for Alphabet shares
entities.description: BofA sets price objective for Alphabet at $217 based on 19x 2026E core GAAP EPS plus cash/share.

entities.name: Alphabet - 2026E Core GAAP EPS Multiple
entities.brief: Valuation multiple used in price objective
entities.description: 19x 2026E core Google GAAP EPS used to set price objective, compares to 10-year average of 22x.

entities.name: Alphabet - 10-Year Average GAAP P/E Multiple
entities.description: Alphabet has traded at an average GAAP P/E multiple of 22x over the last ten years.

entities.name: Alphabet - Double-Digit Revenue Growth Expectation
entities.description: Ongoing expectation of double-digit revenue growth supporting valuation and positive rating.

entities.name: Alphabet - Cloud Margin Expansion Opportunity
entities.brief: Potential for further margin expansion in cloud segment
entities.description: Cloud business margin expansion considered material driver for future value.

entities.name: Alphabet - AI Asset Strength
entities.brief: Strength in AI as a competitive asset
entities.description: Strong AI assets cited as key to sustaining growth and market position.

entities.name: Alphabet - Loss of Search Traffic to AI Tools
entities.brief: Risk of losing search traffic to AI tools from competitors
entities.description: Material downside risk from potential loss of search traffic due to rising use of AI competitors.

entities.name: Alphabet - Adverse Impact from LLM Integration
entities.brief: Risks from delayed or negative LLM impacts on search revenues
entities.description: Risk that LLM (large language model) integration in search could be delayed or hurt search revenues.

entities.name: Alphabet - EU Digital Markets Act Compliance Risk
entities.brief: Regulatory revenue pressure from EU Digital Markets Act
entities.description: Risk of Alphabet facing revenue pressure due to requirements of the EU DMA.

entities.name: Alphabet - DOJ Search Distribution Trial Ruling
entities.brief: Legal risk from ongoing DOJ search trial
entities.description: Potential adverse judge ruling in DOJ search distribution trial is a key legal risk.

entities.name: Alphabet - Increasing Capex and Lower FCF from AI Investments
entities.brief: Risk of higher capex and lower free cash flow due to AI investments
entities.description: Material downside risk of higher capital expenditure and lower FCF as Alphabet invests in AI.
